reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled from a ~600/month baseline (Jun/Jul 2026) to 1180-1260/month in Aug-Sep 2026 (E-05), and the dominant mechanism is errors in actual meter-read values or in billing import/validation of those reads: a majority of disputed bills (1785 of 3025, ~59%) carry an accepted ACTUAL read rather than an ESTIMATED substitute (E-03), which rules out estimate-substitution-from-missed-reads as the primary driver.
